import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from datetime import date
from math import log

pd.set_option("display.width", 250); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth", 80)
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", 300)

TODAY = date(2026,10,12); DOL = date(2024,11,15)
EFF = date(2024,1,1); EXP = date(2024,12,31)
LIMIT, DEDUCTIBLE = 500_000.0, 5_000.0
MAX_NET = LIMIT - DEDUCTIBLE

# ============ 0. MONTE CARLO STABILITY CHECK (resolve the $89,400 vs $89,433) ===
def model(median, sigma, n, seed):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    gross = rng.lognormal(log(median), sigma, n)
    capped = np.minimum(gross, LIMIT)
    return np.where(capped > DEDUCTIBLE, capped - DEDUCTIBLE, 0.0)

pts = [model(60_000, 1.00, 400_000, s).mean() for s in range(1, 21)]
stab = pd.DataFrame({
 "N runs": [20],
 "Point estimate - mean": [np.mean(pts)],
 "Point estimate - min": [np.min(pts)],
 "Point estimate - max": [np.max(pts)],
 "Spread (% of mean)": [(np.max(pts)-np.min(pts))/np.mean(pts)*100],
 "Canonical figure adopted": [np.mean(pts)],
}).round(3)

# Canonical forecast (multi-seed average, sigma=1.0, median gross $60k)
rng = np.random.default_rng(2026)
g_all = rng.lognormal(log(60_000), 1.00, 2_000_000)
n_all = np.where(np.minimum(g_all, LIMIT) > DEDUCTIBLE, np.minimum(g_all, LIMIT) - DEDUCTIBLE, 0.0)
CANON = dict(point=float(n_all.mean()), median=float(np.median(n_all)),
             lo=float(np.percentile(n_all,5)), hi=float(np.percentile(n_all,95)),
             p_limit=float((g_all>LIMIT).mean()))

# ============ 1. FILE METADATA & TIMELINE ==============================
meta = pd.DataFrame([
 ("Policy number","CP-2024-1187","Supplied"),
 ("Named insured","Harborview Retail LLC","Supplied"),
 ("Claimant","Harborview Retail LLC (named insured)","Supplied"),
 ("Policy period",f"{EFF} to {EXP}","Supplied"),
 ("Date of loss",str(DOL),"Supplied"),
 ("Loss location","4820 Meridian Ave N, Seattle, WA 98103","Supplied"),
 ("Jurisdiction","Washington (King County)","Supplied"),
 ("Claim reference","NOT ASSIGNED","MISSING"),
 ("Cause code","WTR-PLUMB-BURST (pipe rupture, back room)","Canonicalized"),
 ("Deductible / Limit",f"${DEDUCTIBLE:,.0f} / ${LIMIT:,.0f}","Supplied, basis unverified"),
 ("Max net payable",f"${MAX_NET:,.0f}","Derived (limit - deductible)"),
], columns=["Field","Value","Source"])

timeline = pd.DataFrame([
 ("2024-01-01","Policy inception","-","-"),
 ("2024-11-15","DATE OF LOSS - pipe burst, back room","319 days into term","46 days before expiry"),
 ("2024-12-31","Policy expiry","-","-"),
 ("UNKNOWN","FNOL to carrier","NOT SUPPLIED","Critical gap"),
 ("UNKNOWN","Proof of loss submitted","NOT RECEIVED","Clock never started"),
 ("2026-10-12","Claim intake / analysis",f"{(TODAY-DOL).days} days after DOL","~1.9 years"),
], columns=["Date","Event","Interval","Note"])

# ============ 2. CONSISTENCY RECONCILIATION ACROSS ALL STEPS ==========
consist = pd.DataFrame([
 ("Policy number","CP-2024-1187","Steps 1-8","CONSISTENT"),
 ("Named insured","Harborview Retail LLC","Steps 1-8","CONSISTENT"),
 ("Date of loss","2024-11-15","Steps 1-8","CONSISTENT"),
 ("Loss location","4820 Meridian Ave N, Seattle WA","Steps 1-8","CONSISTENT"),
 ("Cause of loss","WTR-PLUMB-BURST","Steps 1-8","CONSISTENT"),
 ("Deductible / limit","$5,000 / $500,000","Steps 1-8","CONSISTENT"),
 ("Coverage posture","Conditional / reservation of rights","Steps 2-8","CONSISTENT"),
 ("DOL-to-intake gap","696 days","Steps 2-8","CONSISTENT"),
 ("Forecast point estimate","$89,400 (step 6) vs $89,433 (step 8)","Steps 6 vs 8","RECONCILED - Monte Carlo seed noise (<0.05%)"),
 ("Forecast 90% PI","$6,573-$305,432 vs $6,628-$305,856","Steps 6 vs 8","RECONCILED - same cause"),
 ("Evidence items received","0 of 44","Steps 4-8","CONSISTENT - all outstanding"),
 ("Payment executed","$0","Steps 5-8","CONSISTENT"),
 ("SIU referral","Not made","Steps 5, 7","CONSISTENT - no supportable suspicion"),
 ("Subrogation target","None identified","Steps 5, 7","CONSISTENT"),
 ("Appeal disposition","Noted; forecast unchanged","Step 8","CONSISTENT"),
], columns=["Item","Value(s)","Where it appears","Status"])

# ============ 3. COVERAGE DECISION LEDGER =============================
cov = pd.DataFrame([
 ("Grant of coverage (water damage peril)","SATISFIED","Burst pipe = water damage peril"),
 ("Coverage determination","NOT MADE - CONDITIONAL","Reservation of rights posture"),
 ("Exclusion - seepage >14 days","OPEN","Pivotal; unresolved"),
 ("Exclusion - freezing","OPEN","Occupancy/heat records needed"),
 ("Exclusion - vacancy","OPEN","Occupancy records needed"),
 ("Exclusion - mold/fungus sublimit","OPEN","Sublimit not identified"),
 ("Condition - prompt notice","OPEN / FAILURE RISK","FNOL date unknown"),
 ("Condition - proof of loss","NOT RECEIVED","Response clock not started"),
 ("Condition - duty to mitigate","OPEN","22-month gap"),
 ("Suit-limitation clause","UNREVIEWED","May already bar the claim"),
 ("Payment / indemnity","NONE AUTHORIZED","$0 paid"),
], columns=["Coverage item","Status","Basis"])

# ============ 4. OUTSTANDING ITEMS ====================================
out = pd.DataFrame([
 ("O-01","Claim reference number assigned","Administrative","Critical"),
 ("O-02","Actual FNOL date and method","Notice condition","Critical"),
 ("O-03","Signed and sworn proof of loss","Claim condition","Critical"),
 ("O-04","Policy declarations page","Coverage - limits/deductible basis","Critical"),
 ("O-05","Full policy jacket + water/mold endorsements","Coverage - exclusions","Critical"),
 ("O-06","Suit-limitation and notice conditions","Time bar","Critical"),
 ("O-07","Cause & origin report","Seepage/freeze exclusions","Critical"),
 ("O-08","Preserved failed pipe section","Subrogation + cause","Critical"),
 ("O-09","Occupancy and heating records Nov 2024","Freeze/vacancy exclusions","Critical"),
 ("O-10","Contractor repair estimates","Quantum","High"),
 ("O-11","Inventory list with locations and values","Quantum","High"),
 ("O-12","Mitigation invoice and drying logs","Duty to mitigate / seepage","High"),
 ("O-13","Mortgagee / loss payee confirmation","Payee","High"),
 ("O-14","Appeal documentation (any qualifying item)","Appeal APL-2024-1187-01","High"),
 ("O-15","Evidence file: 44 items uncollected","Investigation","High"),
], columns=["ID","Outstanding item","Bears on","Priority"])

print("="*150); print("CLAIM FILE AUDIT SUMMARY - CP-2024-1187 | Prepared", TODAY); print("="*150)
print("\n--- 0. FORECAST STABILITY (resolving the variance between steps) ---")
print(stab.to_string(index=False))
print(f"  Canonical adopted: point ${CANON['point']:,.0f} | 90% PI ${CANON['lo']:,.0f} - ${CANON['hi']:,.0f} | P(>limit) {CANON['p_limit']*100:.2f}%")
print("\n--- 1. FILE METADATA ---"); print(meta.to_string(index=False))
print("\n--- 2. EVENT TIMELINE ---"); print(timeline.to_string(index=False))
print("\n--- 3. CONSISTENCY RECONCILIATION ---"); print(consist.to_string(index=False))
print("\n--- 4. COVERAGE DECISION LEDGER ---"); print(cov.to_string(index=False))
print("\n--- 5. OUTSTANDING ITEMS ---"); print(out.to_string(index=False))
print("\n--- 6. COMPLETENESS SCORE ---")
checks = {"Policy identified":1,"Insured identified":1,"DOL established":1,"Location established":1,
          "Cause canonicalized":1,"Claim reference":0,"FNOL date":0,"Proof of loss":0,
          "Coverage determination":0,"Exclusions resolved":0,"Quantum documented":0,
          "Evidence collected":0,"Payment made":0,"Subrogation resolved":0,"Time bar reviewed":0}
print(f"  {sum(checks.values())}/{len(checks)} file elements complete = {sum(checks.values())/len(checks)*100:.0f}%")
print(f"  Evidence file: 0 of 44 items received (0%)")
print("\n--- 7. DISPOSITION ---")
print("  REQUESTED:  Close the file")
print("  RECOMMENDED: DO NOT CLOSE. Suspend / hold pending documentation.")
print("  RATIONALE: No POCL, no coverage determination, no quantum, no evidence,")
print("             suit-limitation clause unreviewed, exclusion analysis incomplete.")
print("             Closure now would be premature and inconsistent with a")
print("             reasonable investigation under WAC 284-30-330.")
